framework: Meta Muse Multi-Agent Autonomous Research Orchestrator
primary_vision: Revolutionize AI by establishing autonomous, test-time basis synthesis in frozen foundation models (Delta theta = 0), eliminating catastrophic forgetting and expensive fine-tuning.

inviolable_laws.frozen_backbone: Delta theta == 0 verified via SHA-256 pre and post run
inviolable_laws.zero_leakage: Target labels, options, and answer tokens strictly isolated from basis generators and alignment frames
inviolable_laws.pre_registration: All hypotheses, layers, samples, and metrics pre-registered before data inspection
inviolable_laws.headroom_standard: Baseline accuracy must fall within 40%-70% to eliminate ceiling effects

core_datasets_and_benchmarks.support_sets: 5 disjoint vocabularies (Anglo, Biblical, Greek, Roman, Modern)
core_datasets_and_benchmarks.novel_benchmarks: Difficulty-calibrated N=60 disjoint entities (Planetary and Elemental domains, 2-hop and 3-hop chains, premise permutations)

key_findings.geometric_alignment: CORRECTED 2026-09-23 per adversarial audit: raw cross-vocabulary cosine approx +0.70 with no rotation (EXP065 +0.7186, EXP066 +0.6852); the Procrustes rotation step REDUCED similarity to ~0.00 (delta_cos approx -0.72 / -0.70). The prior '+0.13 to +0.79' claim is retracted.
key_findings.causal_boundary: Static aggregated basis (raw cosine ~0.7) produces Delta M = 0.0 pp on novel vocabularies under full headroom, while same-layer output bridge achieves Delta M = +16.7 pp (EXP065, p = 0.0020) / +13.3 pp (EXP066, p = 0.0078). The Procrustes-rotated condition is excluded from the boundary claim: the rotation did not actually align (see geometric_alignment).
key_findings.central_theorem: REFRAMED 2026-09-23: raw cross-vocabulary geometric similarity (~0.7 cosine) does not yield causal transfer under static injection. Whether a sound (same-space, full-rank) alignment operator would change this verdict is open (cf. EXP067).
